title: Tooling: bound hung isolated test modules without dropping coverage
body:
## Change and scope

Add optional `--module-timeout SECONDS` to the isolated unittest runner. A hung import, test or inherited output pipe now has an explicit per-module failure budget when requested. Timers start at process launch, so queued modules receive their full allowance. Timeouts retain captured diagnostics, clean up ordinary owned processes and fail with code 124; other modules still finish. The unlimited default, exact discovery, assertion policy and completion receipts remain intact.

This is tooling, not a verifier speedup or a new mathematical result. Existing Windows exited-leader and deliberately detached-descendant cleanup limits remain documented.

## Task and overlap

Base `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, refreshed before selection and publication. Verification-engineering session seed 87; changed scope from the `replay-runtime` card to bounding a hung replay rather than optimizing a successful one. Live PRs, #1200/#1166 and cached discussion overlap were checked. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200#discussioncomment-18991625).

This extends earlier isolated-runner cancellation and POSIX descendant cleanup work; registered research-package command timeouts are a separate runner. No dependency on PR3138.

## Validation

`python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_isolated*.py'`

Real subprocess controls cover hung imports, ordinary child cleanup, a completed suite with an open child pipe, partial diagnostics, queued-module budgets, CLI failure, ordinary success/failure, premature zero exit and invalid/NaN/infinite budgets. Existing historical overlay authentication, bytecode isolation, cancellation and exit-cleanup tests are retained. Final results follow below; no repository-wide mathematical suites were run.

## Credit and next questions

Tekalign, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, building on the repository's retained isolated-runner, completion-receipt and cleanup contributions (including ywz65's historical completion work). Apache-2.0. See `docs/ci-verification.md` for the invocation and cleanup scope. Windows native Job Object ownership for this runner remains a separate potential follow-up; no untested cross-platform cleanup claim is made here.

Python 3.12.14: **44 isolated-runner tests pass**. Python 3.14.7: the existing 43-test set passes; after adding the completed-receipt/open-pipe control, all seven deadline tests pass. Missing historical fixtures in the initial sparse checkout were materialized before the successful runs. Existing cancellation controls emit ResourceWarnings; no tests fail. Hosted CI is separate.
